stance_rationale: Claude's no-harvest conclusion is directionally supported by negative IC, failed portfolio t-stat, flat deciles, and failed Calmar. The package still needs revision because mandatory alpha-stage artifacts and lineage are not auditable: alpha_scores is a single-date snapshot, challenge/lineage and 3-agent artifacts are missing, and liquidity/turnover claims conflict with the observed data.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: The mandatory alpha_scores.parquet found under stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260621_008 has columns Ticker,score,ON_MOM,INR,as_of and only one as_of date. m33_score_panel.parquet has 256 monthly dates, but the required alpha_scores artifact is still a single-snapshot file.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Raw price-derived ON_MOM and INR are used with explicit cross-sectional z scoring; no Factor DB NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN artifact was observed.
The available build_pkg.R only packages /tmp RDS objects and does not contain the signal construction code needed to independently verify Date <= sig_date for every monthly score.
This is an OHLC-derived construct rather than a Factor DB factor load; no direct Factor DB parquet load was observed in the available artifact.
No regime, drawdown, volatility, or overlay input is used in the alpha formula.
No financial-statement input is used; the signal is price/Open/Close based.

RF-A2.evidence: Package is a single construct but includes ON_MOM and INR components; no historical component-level ICIR comparison is artifacted.

RF-A3.evidence: Recent 3Y ICIR is about 0.006 versus full ICIR -0.090; no positive recent-only overfit is visible.

RF-A4.evidence: post_neutralization_ic is null and no sector-neutral rerun is artifacted.

RF-A5.evidence: Top-20 selected rows include 129 observations across 65 dates with ADV < 2e8 despite the package claiming an ADV >= 2e8 guard.

RF-A6.evidence: The package cites a 54-cell grid, but only 26 cells ran and no DSR/multiple-testing ledger is provided for the grid.

RF-A7.evidence: alpha_scores.parquet has one as_of date and no Date column.

critical_concerns.description: The required alpha_scores.parquet is a single-snapshot file, not a Date x Ticker x score time-series artifact: it has 352 rows, one as_of date, and no Date column. This directly recreates the Iter 4 failure mode even though m33_score_panel.parquet separately contains 256 dates.

AX-008 triangulation is not satisfied: canonical qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260621_008 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260621_008 are missing, actual artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260621_008, and alpha_package.json, risk_package, optimization_package, challenge_note, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and artifact_lineage.json are absent from the mailbox context.

The package's own hard-gate evidence blocks any alpha graduation: rank_ic -0.0122, ICIR -0.09, rank_IC_t -1.43, portfolio_alpha_t_NW -0.565, sub_stability 0.33, monotonicity 0, and Calmar 0.091 all fail the role prompt thresholds. The no-harvest verdict is correct, but this cannot be softened into approval language.

Liquidity evidence contradicts the package text: the package says ADV>=2e8 guards were applied, but the reconstructed top-20 selections include 129 sub-2e8 observations across 65 dates, and top-decile selections include 151 such observations across 69 dates. Latest-date liquidity is fine, but the historical backtest is not clean under the stated floor.

Turnover is reported as 11.41x/year, which is 1,141% if the unit is a multiplier, exceeding the 1,100% hard cap while the narrative says it is under the cap. The package must reconcile units or mark the cost gate as failed.

PIT verification is not reproducible from the artifacts: build_pkg.R reads /tmp/m33_*.rds objects and writes the draft JSON, but the source construction script that enforces Date <= sig_date is not present in the stage artifacts.

The package uses robustness language after an incomplete grid: 26 of 54 cells ran, the sweep was killed at cell 22, and no DSR ledger is provided. The negative conclusion probably survives, but the wording should not claim a fully deflated grid audit.

supporting_arguments: The economic verdict SCREEN_ROUTE_NONE is supported: top-decile active t is 0.149, D10-D1 t is 0.354, best observed grid portfolio t is 0.464, and all are far below the 2.95 hurdle.
AX-007 is handled correctly at the conclusion level: the package distinguishes novelty/orthogonality from a harvestable top-20 long-only signal and rejects screen-route promotion.
The construct is not an AX-003/004/005 repeat: it is a raw OHLC microstructure/momentum hypothesis, not standalone value, single-signal quality, or low-beta defense.

Open-price coverage evidence is broadly supportive: the package reports 99.937% eligible Open coverage and decomposition error near machine precision, so the negative result is not obviously caused by missing Open data.
unresolved_disputes: Whether regenerated multi-date alpha_scores.parquet will exactly match m33_score_panel.parquet and reproduce the reported rank-IC and portfolio t-stat.
Whether sector-neutral IC deterioration would trigger RF-A4; post_neutralization_ic is null.
Whether the 15bps cost and turnover calculation uses multiplier or percent units; 11.41x appears above the hard cap.
Whether the absent risk/optimizer context is intentionally not yet produced or an artifact-routing failure.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that the draft package is PIT-clean and audit-ready despite the mandatory alpha_scores artifact being single-date and the reproducible signal-construction code being absent from the stage artifacts.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate alpha_scores.parquet as a multi-sig-date Date x Ticker x score artifact at the canonical requested path, with at least the 256 monthly dates already present in m33_score_panel.parquet.
Provide the full signal construction script or factor_engine_proposal.R that creates m33_score_panel from raw OHLC and proves Date <= sig_date for each row.
Add challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json, and reconcile the qepm/stage_artifacts versus stage_artifacts path mismatch.
Recompute or restate the liquidity and turnover gates under the 2e8 ADV and 1,100% annual turnover constraints.
Either complete the 54-cell grid with a DSR/multiple-testing ledger or remove robustness language tied to the incomplete sweep.
rationalization_red_flags: One campaign data point, NOT a structural limit.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with Claude's no-harvest direction, but not with the artifact sufficiency or robustness framing. The critique should approve the negative economic finding only after the time-series alpha artifact, lineage, and hard-constraint inconsistencies are fixed.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the alpha agent regenerate alpha_scores.parquet with all monthly sig_dates and show it matches m33_score_panel.parquet row-for-row on Date, Ticker, and score?
Where is the source builder that computes overnight_d and intraday_d with only information available at each sig_date?
Why do selected historical rows breach the claimed ADV >= 2e8 guard if the package says the guard was applied?
Does turnover_proxy 11.41 mean 11.41x/year, and if so why is it described as under the 1,100% cap?
